name: What is the average cost to install kitchen floor tile?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost to install kitchen floor tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of kitchen floor tile installation varies significantly based on factors such as the type of tile chosen, the complexity of the design, the size of the kitchen, and the condition of the existing subfloor. Generally, homeowners can expect to pay between $8 to $18 per square foot for professional installation, including labor and basic materials like mortar and grout. High-end materials or intricate patterns can increase this cost. It's always best to get a detailed quote tailored to your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Average kitchen floor tile installation costs range from $8 to $18 per square foot, depending on tile type, kitchen size, and installation complexity.
